stage.LAUNCH.aim: Be visible and earn your first ratings, on a thin but positive margin.
stage.RAMP.aim: Step the price up ₹10–20 a week and keep what works.

home.title: Sahi Daam
home.lead: Offline sellers price the way they did in their shop: cost plus a markup. Online, part of every batch never becomes a sale — and the shipping, packaging and returns you pay land on the sales that survive. Nobody shows you that number.
home.hookCaption: A ₹300 kurti costing ₹150. Of 100 orders dispatched, 17 never reach the buyer and 13 come back. Meesho absorbs the RTO shipping and COD handling — but you still pay shipping and GST on the 83 delivered, return shipping on the 13 returns, packaging on all 100, and lose the 6 that cannot be resold.
home.card1.title: Price any product
home.card1.body: Your true floor from your own cost, RTO and returns — then the market band beside it, with a recommendation for every stage of the product’s life.
home.card2.title: Follow a seller’s journey
home.card2.body: 26 weeks of one kurti, priced three ways on the same market — Sahi Daam, the seller’s instinct, and Meesho’s range. All three make money; Sahi Daam ends ₹66,898 ahead of instinct and ₹40,307 ahead of the range.
home.card3.title: See what changes
home.card3.body: What Meesho shows a seller today, next to what Sahi Daam adds — and every number in this prototype with the source it came from.
home.builtBy: Team Taraazu · Meesho DICE Challenge 3.0 · Problem statement 4

floor.lead: Meesho charges 0% commission and no COD fee, and does not bill you for shipping a refused order back. What you do pay — shipping and GST on orders that reach the buyer, return shipping on customer returns, packaging on every order, and unsellable returns — still lands on fewer sales than you dispatch. Here is the lowest price that leaves you whole.

policy.forwardOnRtoHint: Off by default: you pay forward shipping only on delivered orders. 2026 seller guides disagree — switch on to see the other reading.
policy.gstRegisteredHint: Your listed price then includes 5% output GST (you keep price ÷ 1.05), and the GST on Meesho’s fees comes back as input credit. 5% is apparel’s rate under ₹1,000 — an assumption for other categories.

auth.pitch: Tell us a little about your shop once, and every number after that is yours — your cost, your buyers, your returns. Not a category average.
auth.why1: Where your buyers live decides how many parcels come back — and that moves your floor more than anything else.
auth.why2: Your cost and your parcel weight pick the shipping slab you actually pay.
auth.why3: Answer once and Aapki Laagat opens already filled in.
auth.demoSellerSub: The demo seller: one kurti, ₹150 cost, 350 g. No sign-up needed.
auth.orSignIn: or sign in with an account
auth.warningBody: There is no server. Accounts are kept in this browser only, the password is not securely hashed, and anyone using this device can read them. Please do not reuse a real password.
auth.error.noAccount: No account with that email. Try signing up, or use one of the demo logins below.
auth.error.badEmail: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.taken: There is already an account with that email.

assumptions.note: CITED values come from a published source and DERIVED ones from the deck’s worked example. Numbers marked ASSUMPTION are placeholders for the prototype; in production, Meesho fills these from its own data.
